intent: Implement TelemetryProperties (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Externalized operational values of context Telemetry Ingestion / Stream Processing as an immutable record bound by Spring configuration properties with prefix telemetry (constructor binding, kebab-case keys: reorder-window, reorder-buffer-capacity, validated-stream-capacity, broadcast-capacity, emit-retry-timeout, boundaries). The values live in src/main/resources/application.yml (ApplicationYml unit); no default literal in code. It is registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration through @EnableConfigurationProperties (no @Component here).

methods.signature: TelemetryProperties(Duration reorderWindow, int reorderBufferCapacity, int validatedStreamCapacity, int broadcastCapacity, Duration emitRetryTimeout, List<SensorMetricBoundary> boundaries)
methods.semantics: reorderWindow > 0, all capacities >= 1, emitRetryTimeout > 0, boundaries copied unmodifiable; violations throw IllegalArgumentException.
Max samples read for one window, >= 1.
Bound of the validated sample stream buffer, >= 1.
Bound of the downstream broadcast replay buffer, >= 1.
Maximum bounded busy-loop time for a concurrent sink emit, positive.
